description: Fuel, a vehicle, a border fee, a bribe, a deposit somewhere else. Every one of those is a price, and the price rises exactly when demand does.
energy_note: Safety, sold at auction, during the auction.

aspect: The immobile are the old, the sick and their carers
description: Someone who cannot be moved anchors everyone who loves them. One bedridden parent immobilises a household of five, and everyone in it knows the arithmetic without saying it.
energy_note: Doing the maths on a person you love.

aspect: Staying is later reinterpreted as choosing
description: Those who left ask why you did not. Those who stayed ask why others did. Neither question has an answer that survives contact with the actual constraints, and both get asked for decades.
energy_note: Defending a decision that was never available.

aspect: SECONDARY - the guilt splits the family permanently
description: The brother who got out sends money and cannot visit. The brother who stayed receives it and cannot say what it costs him to. Twenty years later they are polite with each other.
energy_note: A family that works fine and is never close again.
